verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a vendor-maintained migration overview covering two strategies, basic export/import and trickle migration. It also provides an open-source tool that bulk-creates users from JSON/CSV via the Backend API while respecting rate limits. The evidence never says whether existing password hashes can be imported or whether migrated users avoid forced resets, which is the core of the story. It also names no competitor-specific guides. missing for 10: documented password-hash import / no-reset guarantee, provider-specific migration guides (e.g., from named competitors), hands-on or independent corroboration of a smooth migration.
